## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><p>Click a duct or fitting. Ctrl/⌘+click adds components to the selection and table.</p><h3>Developer integration</h3><p><code>viewer.onViewChange</code> provides selected GlobalIds. The page resolves them through <code>viewer.IfcAPI.GetExpressIdFromGuid</code>, then queries entity names, storeys and property sets from its independently opened native model. It does not ship a cached property table. An outdated query cannot replace a newer selection.</p><p>The page keeps its native IFC model open for selection queries and closes it when the page is unloaded. <code>viewer.clear()</code> controls only the rendered model. Native calls run on the main thread. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
